chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhal from Yunus ibn Ya'qub said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): The obligatory prayer arrived while I was in the Ka'ah; should I pray in it? He said, 'Pray.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.اَلْكَعْبَةُ: The Ka'ah (the cube-shaped structure in Mecca)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying inside the Ka'ah if the prayer time arrives while one is already inside?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the fiqh of praying inside the Ka'ah, a subject of scholarly discussion regarding whether one must exit to perform the prayer or if the interior is a valid prayer space. By instructing Yunus ibn Ya'qub to 'pray' without specifying an exit, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) affirms the validity of the prayer within the structure itself, reflecting the practical flexibility in Shia jurisprudence for maintaining ritual purity and timeliness during the Hajj season.
